values.note: 28 sites: 24 in Loop A (15 reservable, 9 first-come) and 4 in Loop B (sites 25-28, pull-throughs; 25-26 equestrian with corrals). 17 barrier-free. Catalog lengths 25-45 ft in Loop A (most 32-40), 50-60 ft for the Loop B pull-throughs; the Forest Service gives 45 ft. Most large and pull-through sites need levelling.

values.note: 19 sites reservable on recreation.gov up to 4 days ahead; 9 Loop A sites (001, 004, 005, 008, 011, 012, 020, 021, 023) are first come, first served. 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums. 2026 reservation season May 8 - Sept 26; recreation.gov's 2027 table starts June 5. Livestock only at sites 25 and 26.

note: USFS campground on a south-facing ponderosa/Gambel oak hillside overlooking Thompson Park, about 7 mi east of Mancos off US-160, ~7,640 ft; a short trail leads to a Ute-scarred 'target tree'. Drinking water is trucked in (no RV fill). Well-maintained access road suitable for a 23-ft RV. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (233350) API/rates/catalog: confirmed max 45 ft, pull-throughs, potable water, no electric, $24 (2026 and 2027), reservable; added count 28, toilets/no dump/no showers, season May-Sept, booking (19 reservable, 9 FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 14 nights, 2/3-night minimums, reservation season May 8 - Sept 26).
